issues.issue: Whether the four new documents are admissible on appeal
issues.applicant_position: The new documents show people want to hurt him and are looking for him.
issues.result_text: The RAD finds the four new documents inadmissible under subsection 110(4) of the Act.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in assessing credibility and the risk of harm from gangs
issues.applicant_position: The RPD erred in fact and law, gave unintelligible reasons, ignored evidence, and the risk is real.
issues.result_text: No significant error; credibility is determinative and the omissions and contradictions undermine his account.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant's general allegations of error meet RAD Rule 3(3)(g)
issues.applicant_position: Makes general allegations of RPD error without identifying the specific sections or where the errors occur.
issues.result_text: Rule 3(3)(g) is not met, so the RAD will not guess at errors, but it still assessed the record independently.
